answer: Sustained Attention Tenure Queue. Each identity must answer randomized, time-boxed attention probes sent through a shared beacon; misses lower its routing weight and repeated misses suspend service. An attacker pays the continuous opportunity cost of staffing every duplicate to remain responsive across idle periods, not a one-time fee. At the market’s zenith, probe density rises, raising that cost. During tundra-like lulls, probes arrive at unpredictable intervals, so automation must still hold attention.
